test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct idiom for the word highlighted in bold.

Since Jatin purchased his new gaming console, he has turned into a true **couch potato**, watching TV for hours.

options.text: A person who eats only potatoes.
A person who spends a lot of time sitting and watching TV.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"couch potato"** is an idiom that refers to someone who spends a lot of time sitting or lying down, typically watching television, and engaging in minimal physical activity. (सोफे पर आलसी बैठने वाला व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** Ever since he got his new streaming subscription, he has become a couch potato, watching shows all day.
 
 

 
• The idiom relates to people who exhibit sedentary habits, which often result in lack of exercise or activity. (बैठे रहने की आदतें)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.</
